entities.name: Louis Marie Antoine de Noailles
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louis Marie de Noailles was a French Army officer and politician who served in the American Revolutionary War and French Revolutionary Wars. The second son of Philippe, duc de Mouchy, he was a member of Mouchy branch of the Noailles family of French nobility.
